name: W. H. Minty
bio: W. H. Minty of Minneapolis took a telegraph post at Medora in January 1885 and worked as night operator, with E. W. Jordan filling in during his trip to Augusta, Wisconsin, in summer 1885, which the paper teased might end in marriage. He was relieved as night operator in April 1886, and by November 1886 he had left a similar post to take an office on the Missouri Pacific at Lincoln, Nebraska.
